name: cepheus-ide
description: Cepheus: an open-source AI coding agent for your terminal. Works out of the box with free NVIDIA Nemotron models (no key needed), your own NVIDIA key, local models (Ollama, LM Studio) or your own Anthropic, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible keys.
author: Cepheus contributors

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run build:web && npm test
scripts.build:web: cd .. && npx vite build --config vite.config.web.ts && cd cli && node scripts/copy-web.mjs
